memories.name: Do Not Go Gently
memories.objective: Get through a stealth infiltration and a big Man O' War fight, then return to Great Inagua.
steps: Optionally prepare at Great Inagua: restore the Harbourmaster (500 Reales) and buy ship upgrades.
Sail to coords 929, 545, northeast of the hideout.
Clear the ships circling the area so your approach stays unnoticed.
Meet Charles Vane and Edward Thatch, who talk about the Sage.
Follow the pirate south on foot, staying above him on boards and branches, and tag nearby guards with Eagle Vision.
Tail the pirate and his escort to a house, using bushes for cover.
Slip through an open door, circle to the far side and take cover near a lone guard by a campfire.
Enter the nearby room and climb a ramp to a signal flare.
Cross boards to the northwest, double-assassinate the guards below and climb the last staircase for a cutscene.
Run through the fire, jump through a wall gap and follow the burning path back to the Jackdaw.
Fight the Man O' War alongside allied pirate ships; save small boardable ships for mid-fight repairs, then board the incapacitated Man O' War and clear its crew.
Escape to open water to trigger the return to Great Inagua.
tips: Upgrades the page lists for prep: Broadside Cannons II, Armored Hull II, a Ram upgrade, Heavy Shot, Mortar, Round and Heated Shot I.
Red barrels hurt grouped soldiers but can hurt your own crew too.
Enemies can act as human shields against ranged fire.
Kicking enemies off the ship is a quick takedown near walls.
Ranged shots and quickfire are fastest against enemy captains.
gaps: No optional or full sync objectives (page says none exist).
No guard counts for the infiltration.
Nothing on the Blackbeard side quest the map unlocks.

memories.name: Vainglorious Bastards
memories.objective: Chase a Royal African Co. frigate together with Charles Vane.
steps: Sail west to coords 748, 439 and dock beside Vane's ship, the Ranger; Vane briefs you and the lead points to Cruz (439, 410).
Follow Vane across open water; a rescue brings him aboard the Jackdaw before the chase starts.
Pursue the Royal African Co. frigate, circling at a distance instead of being lured toward Fort Cabo de Cruz.
Wear the frigate down with Mortars from range, then immobilize it.
Make a Swivel Gun pass to thin its crew, then board and fully break morale.
Learn where the Princess is, which leads into Marooned.
tips: Circling wide of Fort Cabo de Cruz avoids a two-front fight.
gaps: No detailed route or positioning for the frigate fight.

memories.name: Marooned
memories.objective: After Vane's betrayal, track him across Isla Providencia and knock him out.
steps: Climb the shipwreck to the north and sync a Viewpoint; continue west along the mast to a Secret that gives a Data File.
Head west to the waterfall ruins; next Viewpoint is at 475, 17. Follow Vane up a wall until he jumps off.
Take the Keys atop a building to the southwest and sync the second Viewpoint there, then dive off and go north.
Slide under a tree to meet Vane again, now armed and hostile.
Chase him through the ruins using bushes and walls for cover.
Sneak close, dodge his shot when his loading meter nearly fills, and keep moving after each shot because he switches to explosives if you linger.
Circle behind him to break line of sight, climb up and knock him out, ending the sequence.
tips: His direct hits can remove most of Edward's health, so use cover.
gaps: Third Viewpoint location is not described.
Locations of the Mayan Stelae and chests on the island are not given (page only counts 3 Viewpoints, 2 Stelae, 4 chests, some opening later).
No precise Vane fight instructions beyond general tactics.
